svg.title: Joint training across institutions
svg.desc: Seven working steps connect hosting or sending arrangements, shared supervision, formal recognition and handover. Three checks show when to revise or seek confirmation. Solid arrows move downwards, gold diamonds are decisions, and dashed lines return after correction.This is working guidance, not an approved institutional programme. Supervisory agreement, institutional approval, completed research and formal recognition are distinct. Apply the rules and authorised decisions relevant to each student; shared supervision does not itself confer a joint or double degree.

text.tspan: Seven working steps connect hosting or sending arrangements, shared supervision, formal recognition and handover. Three
